headline: Xhaka has created 5 big chances for Sunderland and still has no assists. The PL players creating the most with zero assists after 6 gameweeks
body: Put together some interesting data on Premier League players who have created the most chances so far but are still waiting for an assist. The ones that stood out: Xhaka has set up 5 big chances, the kind you'd expect to be scored, and has nothing to show for it. Iwobi has 13 chances created and 4 of them big ones. McAtee has created the most of anyone on zero, 14. Ødegaard has 12, and Savinho 11 in only 331 minutes. Rashford is the odd one: 13 chances created but none of them big chances. Would love to hear your thoughts on which of these you'd back for returns in the next few GM's? (Data source: The Prism , a football scouting and analytics tool I'm currently building.
